proposals.evidence: Turner’s first vātiṅgaṇa branch explicitly includes Oriya bāiṅgaṇa, Punjabi baĩgaṇ/vaĩgaṇ and Hindi baigan/baĩgun. These intact Oriya/Gujari/Haryanvi/Pothwari responses fit that inherited regional family. The retained-t northwestern forms, explicitly traced through Iranian in Turner, and responses containing a second crop name are excluded.

proposals.evidence: Turner explicitly includes Hindi dhūl and Western Pahari/Jaunsari dhūṛ dust, with Kotgarhi dhvḷo. These Haryanvi, Jaunsari and Kullui forms preserve the dust stem with ordinary regional vowels/endings; this excludes longer dhūdhar and rajas-like responses whose extra morphology needs separate evidence.
